name: Lagoon Immersed Rest Cradle
scope: One original proposed aquatic rest component. No recovered assignment, occupancy or biological certification.

basin.shell_object: Hollow continuous basin shell with interior floor

support.type: wide concave immersed support with rising rear and raised lateral contours
support.immersion_note: Most of the central/lateral support is below proposed waterline; rear slope emerges. This is not a solved body pose.

proposed_fluid_broadphase_only_bounds.meaning: AABB for planning only; actual future fluid must be bounded by cavity and exclude support material. No closed water-volume mesh or physics supplied.

water.collision_policy: NO_SOLID_COLLISION; exclude WaterSurface_VisualOnly and all ripple ribbons from any static collision generation
water.surface_construction: original planar radial mesh with exact convex-polygon subtraction of raised source support triangles; translucent material plus six authored ripple ribbons
water.simulation: absent: no buoyancy, water quantity, flow, splash, thermal/chemical/environmental regulation or save state

approach.note: Low transfer edge only, not a walk-through opening, ramp or certified accessible facility.

service.mounting_status: nonfunctional visible service/control interfaces; actual UI, plumbing and cleaning interaction pending

collision.status: proposal only; no physics bodies exported
collision.shell: static concave triangle surface or validated multi-convex decomposition preserving cavity; NEVER one convex hull over entire basin
collision.support: static concave candidate; exact contoured top is actual contact surface
collision.future_water_detection: separate nonblocking Area3D volume must be authored/tested during integration

body_fit_and_animation: pending original actor dimensions, rest transitions, transfers and actual contact tests
validation_limits: Component source/export geometry and preview only; no Game import
No species compatibility, live water, body fit, rest animation, accessibility, environmental or structural load certification
No room layout or clearance outside stated reservation verified
No occupancy/berth changes, catalogue registration, backups or publication
Preview studio excluded from GLB; no exported lights
authoring: Original deterministic Python meshes and simple materials. No downloads, image textures, fees or external asset service.
